Show HN: Persist – A simple Go configuration library
items.summary: I just released persist, a small Go library for saving one typed value to disk, that's it. It can be used for a single string up to an entire struct. It uses JSON encoding and writes to user's config dir. It's initialized generically with the type + an optional default value, then has two methods - Pull (which loads the saved value or returns a default on first run) and Push (which saves it in the user’s config directory using a temp file and rename). It’s completely new, so no users yet. I’m curious whether this saves anyone enough boilerplate to use? https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/clmncol/per

Show HN: Autostrum – Play along with guitar tabs at your own tempo
items.summary: I’m excited to share a project I’ve been working on for a while. Autostrum helps guitarists learn songs faster by playing back interactive tablature with real guitar audio samples instead of synthetic MIDI. You can slow down and loop difficult passages until you’re comfortable, plus use built-in practice tools like a metronome, tuner, and warmup exercises. If you're a guitar player, I’d love for you to check it out and share your feedback! Here’s the repo link if you are interested: https://github.com/michaelongaro/Autostrum

items.title: Show HN: Relaticle, an open-source CRM that Claude and ChatGPT can work in
items.summary: I asked rela (the assistant inside my open source crm relaticle) once for a task and a note (in a test workspace). It shows me a plan, one line per change, one approve button. There was no task or note until I clicked approve. Relaticle (my open source CRM) has an MCP server for AI agents right in the core app. Claude and ChatGPT connect to it, and over the MCP protocol, they don't need a plan, they don't need an approve button, the writes just land right away. Not sure yet if those writes should wait for approval too. I started writing this in August 2024. It's written in Laravel + PostgreSQL

items.summary: Hello HN. Cordium is a FOSS, self-hosted, identity-based, general-purpose sandbox platform built on Kubernetes. items.title: Show HN: Dawdle, compete with friends and family in a daily 5 minute word puzzle
items.summary: Hey HN, I originally made this game as a bit of fun between some friends and family. Turned out they quite enjoyed it and encouraged me to share it around a bit. Everyone in your group is given the same 15 letters, you're given five minutes to find the best words you can with the letters provided, scrabble style scoring. One of the letters is a 2x tile, that will double your points for that word. Longer words get additional bonuses, as well as additional bonuses in the group for longest word and most words. There's also a daily "global dawdle" where you can see what the best score you can get

items.title: Show HN: Tartelette – an RP2040 emulator and breakout simulator
items.summary: This is something I made (with LLM help) in order to easily develop and test firmware for Eurorack modules. It is a staple of the maker, retro and synth scenes and, while there are already a couple of emulators out there for it, I couldn't find any which allowed me to test my firmware with (simualted) electronics attached.
